“

Quality is never an accident. It is the result of honest work, careful sourcing, and a promise we make to every customer who walks through our door.

MIAN AFTAB AHMAD & MIAN IFTIKHAR AHMAD

Three decades of trust, built brand by brand.

What began in 1992 as a single home appliance outlet has grown into a group of three trusted names in Lahore's electronics market — Sitara Electronics, Sitara Electric Centre, and GM Electronics. Each brand was built to serve a different corner of the same promise: genuine products, fair pricing, and service that treats every customer like family.

Founders Mian Aftab Ahmad and Mian Iftikhar Ahmad have guided that growth personally, staying close to the shop floor even as the business expanded from retail counters to wholesale supply and, now, to online ordering.

The People Behind the Brands

Meet the Founders

Two brothers, one standard for quality — leading GM Electronics and the Sitara brands with hands-on involvement in every part of the business.

FOUNDER & CEO

Mian Aftab Ahmad

Co-founder of Sitara Electronics, Sitara Electric Centre, and GM Electronics. Mian Aftab Ahmad has spent decades building direct relationships with manufacturers and customers alike, shaping a business built on genuine wholesale pricing and dependable after-sales service.

FOUNDER & CEO

Mian Iftikhar Ahmad

Co-founder of Sitara Electronics, Sitara Electric Centre, and GM Electronics. Mian Iftikhar Ahmad leads day-to-day operations across the group's showrooms and warehouse, focused on continuous growth while keeping quality and customer trust at the center of every decision.
